seo.title: Costing — Kickback
seo.description: Costing matches vendor invoices to your CRM jobs, automatically. Sherwin-Williams, Home Depot Pro, Lowe's Pro, and more. Built for the keyboard.
seo.ogDescription: Vendor invoices matched to your CRM jobs in seconds. Cleared with the keyboard. Posted straight to your CRM.

hero.lede: Costing pulls vendor invoices in from the vendors you already use, matches each one to the right job, and posts it to your CRM with a single keystroke.
hero.metaHtml: Part of the Kickback Platform · Sign-In or Create an Account

sections.title: From zero to costed in minutes.
sections.lede: Connect your CRM and your vendor accounts. Our platform watches for new invoices, uses context from the invoice and your job data to suggest the best match, and lets you confirm with a single keystroke.

items.title: New invoices arrive in your inbox.
items.body: Invoices can come from any vendor, via their portal, emailed receipts or PDFs, or any other way they send them to you. Costing pulls in the details like line items and totals, P/O numbers, and more, so nothing gets re-typed.

items.title: Costing suggests the best match.
items.body: We rank likely matches using the signals on each invoice and across your job data: names, dates, locations, references, and historical patterns. The best options rise to the top so you don't have to search for the right job.

items.title: Confirm and Post to your CRM.
items.bodyHtml: Match an existing line item or create a new one, then hit <kbd>Enter</kbd>. The cost is posted to the matched job, the receipt PDF is attached in your CRM, and your job costing reports stay accurate.

sections.title: Clear your queue without even thinking.
sections.bodyHtml: The whole inbox runs on the keyboard. <kbd>J</kbd>/<kbd>K</kbd> through the queue, <kbd>1</kbd>–<kbd>3</kbd> to pick a suggested job, <kbd>Enter</kbd> to confirm. Hard ones go to <kbd>S</kbd>earch. Junk goes to <kbd>O</kbd>verhead or <kbd>I</kbd>gnore. Built for the operator who'd rather get their Saturday back.

bullets.title: Vendor Support
bullets.text: Whether your vendors have a portal, email you receipts, or something else, our platform supports it all.

bullets.title: Smart Suggestions
bullets.text: Costing reads the P/O field, the customer name on the receipt, active job dates, and more to suggest the best match. Most invoices match in one click.

bullets.title: Synced to your CRM
bullets.text: No need to re-type anything or use another app. The invoice is posted, the receipt PDF is attached, and your job-costing reports stay accurate, all in the CRM you already use.

bullets.title: Data-Integrity Checks
bullets.text: Spot duplicate invoices, jobs with no cost items yet, and zero-cost line items waiting on a receipt. No more manual double-checking.

suite.body: Vendor invoices from anywhere get matched, posted, and attached without manual data entry, right into your CRM. No more hunting for receipts or guessing where an invoice belongs.
